dedupe_keys.name: livorno municipal property leases and lease costs 2013 2014

description: The Municipality of Livorno publishes a property-rental series covering assets leased out by the municipality and the costs of leases or concessions taken by the administration. The source hierarchy links active and passive rental containers to their 2013 and 2014 datasets. Active-property descriptions list the address, floor area, monthly rent and contract end date. Passive-lease descriptions identify expenditure on leases and concessions but do not establish the same property-level fields, so those fields are not transferred to that component. The 2014 active record is dated 30 July, while passive records refer to September 2013 and June 2014. All seven native entries belong to one explicitly named rental series. Containers and annual entries overlap and are retained together. These are records of municipal property and its rental costs; they do not establish building condition, occupancy, energy use or current rental availability. No specific simulation application is stated. Related municipal building-stock information describes different physical attributes. Native metadata lists ZIP distributions and states CC BY-SA 2.0; internal file formats and current download availability remain unverified. No rental file, archive or individual record was read.
